hook: Running an LLM on 5,600 Lambdas costs 80x more

beats.say: Noah Lindner split a 9.3 gigabyte Qwen fine-tune across AWS Lambdas, one job per layer per block of tokens.
It worked, but reading a 4,000 token document took 17 seconds and cost 3.4 cents, about 8 dollars 40 per million tokens.
A hosted decision model charges 10 cents per million tokens, making his version more than 80 times pricier. His lesson: use a GPU.
